property_summary: For any non-empty _tos list and any target callee that reverts on unknown selector, the reference C always bubbles the callee success (i.e. its transfer(...) call succeeds only if each callee invocation with the correct transferFrom selector succeeds); the mutant uses a wrong selector so calls to a callee that only implements the correct transferFrom signature will fail and thus the mutant's transfer(...) will revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the keccak256 signature to an incorrect selector so external calls revert/return false differently than original.
